mapper.select: SELECT id, todo_id, title, position, completed FROM todo_subtasks WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} ORDER BY position, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_subtasks (todo_id, title, position, completed) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{title}, #{position}, #{completed})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo_subtasks SET completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id} AND todo_id = #{todoId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM todo_subtasks WHERE id = #{id} AND todo_id = #{todoId}
